_comment: Wan2.2 TI2V 5B text-to-video ComfyUI API-format workflow. Derived node-for-node from the OFFICIAL template at github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/main/templates/video_wan2_2_5B_ti2v.json (fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com, node ids/links/widget values verified against that source; the {{...}} tokens below are substituted by ComfyUIProvider._fill_template before submission). This is the API ('prompt') format ComfyUI's POST /prompt endpoint expects, converted from the UI graph-save format of the official template. No start_image node - Wan22ImageToVideoLatent's start_image input is simply omitted for pure text-to-video, per the official tutorial at docs.comfy.org/tutorials/video/wan/wan2_2 which describes this same graph handling both modes.

8._comment: Explicit tiled decode (not the default VAEDecode) - ComfyUI's own automatic OOM-retry-with-tiling fallback still uses tile sizes too large for 16GB cards on a multi-second Wan2.2 clip (observed: retry itself OOM'd trying to allocate 18.56 GiB). Small, fixed tile/temporal sizes keep VAE decode VRAM use bounded regardless of card size, at a small quality/time cost.
